shortDescription: GitHub user profile view with overview state.
fullDescription: Presents the github-user-profile view in its overview state with a GitHub-style dark profile layout, top navigation, tabbed profile sections, pinned popular repositories, and a yearly contribution activity heatmap. Supports configurable profile data, selected tab, repository list, achievement badges, contribution totals, and contribution grid data while keeping tabs, search, year selection, and settings controls interactive through view props and local presentational state.
